test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Dolphins are named among the __intelligent__ animals on earth.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. most intelligent .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is a superlative form comparison, indicating that dolphins are one of the top animals in terms of intelligence.
 
• To correctly express this, the phrase "the intelligent animals" should be replaced with "the most intelligent animals".
 
• The other options (intelligenter, more intelligent, intelligentest) are either incorrect in form or do not fit the context of the sentence.

Correct sentence: *Dolphins are named among the **most intelligent** animals on earth*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparative Form:**

 
 
• **Structure:** Adjective + -er or more + Adjective.
 
• **Example:** Dolphins are more intelligent than many other animals.
 
• **Usage: **Used for comparing two entities.
 
 
 
• **Superlative Form:**
 
 
• **Structure: **the + Adjective + -est or the most + Adjective.
 
• **Example: **Dolphins are the most intelligent animals in the ocean.
 
• **Usage: **Used for comparing one entity with all others in its group.
